articles.summary: Ancient light suggests that young galaxies were already sending carbon and oxygen into surrounding space. The finding helps explain how the universe gained its chemical variety.
articles.title: Early Galaxies Shared Their Elements

articles.summary: Extremely brief electrical pulses reveal how two superconductors respond to strong currents. The experiment explores their inner limits while still requiring cold conditions.
articles.title: Tiny Pulses Test Superconductors’ Limits

articles.summary: Scientists found that a small chemical group helps RNA form droplets. The research offers clues about how molecules might have gathered before cells existed.
articles.title: A Tiny Chemical Group Helps RNA Gather
